map.输入行驶里程、车辆油耗与油价，估算单程油费、每公里成本与人均分摊，并对比不同车型: Enter trip distance, vehicle consumption and fuel price to estimate one-way fuel cost, cost per km and per-person share, and compare fuel cost between vehicle types.
map.行程油费 = 里程(km) ÷ 100 × 百公里油耗(L) × 油价；每公里成: Trip fuel cost = distance(km) ÷ 100 × consumption(L/100km) × fuel price; cost per km = fuel cost ÷ distance; cost per person = fuel cost ÷ occupants; alternative option fuel cost = distance ÷ 100 × comparison consumption × fuel price.
map.同车高速匀速约 6~7L/100km，市区拥堵可到 9~11L/100km。长途: The same car uses about 6~7L/100km cruising on the highway and up to 9~11L/100km in city traffic. Use the highway figure for long trips and measured values for commuting.
map.把「油耗 × 油价」换成「百公里电耗 × 电价」，公共快充另加服务费。家充谷电单: Replace "consumption × fuel price" with "kWh/100km × electricity price", plus the service fee at public fast chargers. Off-peak home charging is cheap, giving clear energy-cost advantages.
map.💡 想算得更准：用最近一次「加满到加满」的加油量与对应里程反推真实百公里油耗，再: 💡 For better accuracy: derive real consumption from your latest "fill to fill" quantity and the distance covered, then enter it here.
map.出行前输入行驶里程、车辆油耗与当前油价，估算单程油费，规划预算。: Before a trip, enter distance, vehicle consumption and current fuel price to estimate one-way fuel cost and plan the budget.
map.对比不同路线或不同车型时，用油费差量化选择更省的方案。: When comparing routes or vehicles, quantify the fuel cost difference to choose the cheaper option.
map.反过来由预算与油价推导可行驶里程，控制出行范围。: Or work back from budget and fuel price to the distance you can afford, keeping the trip within range.
map.行程 300km、车辆油耗 7L/100km、油价 8 元/L；油费=300÷1: A 300km trip at 7L/100km with fuel at 8 yuan/L gives 300÷100×7×8 = 168 yuan. In a 9L/100km car it becomes 300÷100×9×8 = 216 yuan, so the 48 yuan gap is what model choice costs over that distance.
map.为什么实际油费比算的高？: Why is the real fuel bill higher than the estimate?
map.估算用等速理想油耗，实际城市拥堵、空调、载重、胎压都会抬高；且油价含标号差异。用: Estimates assume ideal steady-speed consumption, while congestion, A/C, load and tire pressure all push the real figure up, and prices vary by fuel grade. Enter a recently measured consumption figure rather than the official cycle value.
